first_incorrect_transition: foreground conversation was contaminated by the active language goal; unrelated angular momentum question received a process/interpretation response instead of a factual answer
implementation_constraints: do not make provider output authoritative
do not send actual operator messages
source repair requires review before implementation

primary_review_findings.expected_behavior: Answer the unrelated foreground question normally, keep the background goal separate, and surface any goal update only as an inline side-thread.
primary_review_findings.observed_transition: active language goal + unrelated angular momentum question -> meta interpretation response instead of factual answer
primary_review_findings.why_it_matters: The active background goal contaminated ordinary foreground chat. The goal may influence interpretation silently, but must not replace the foreground topic.

primary_review_findings.expected_behavior: Record exact information need, local Qwen prompt/response, insufficiency rationale, local retrieval checked, material block, and smallest external packet before asking for provider authority.
primary_review_findings.observed_transition: provider-learning packet requested before a recorded local Qwen insufficiency finding
primary_review_findings.why_it_matters: External provider help was treated as useful rather than locally proven necessary. Useful is not enough for escalation.

primary_review_findings.expected_behavior: Classify whether the turn concerns the active goal, a side-thread reply, or an unrelated foreground topic before applying active-goal lessons.
primary_review_findings.observed_transition: explicit false-transfer guard mentioning angular momentum still triggered the active reference lesson
primary_review_findings.why_it_matters: The transfer check is too lexical and treats instruction text as applicability evidence.

primary_review_findings.expected_behavior: On goal completion or review boundary, post a normal chat review such as: "I completed X. Here is what I gathered: Y. I retained Z. Remaining uncertainty: W."
primary_review_findings.observed_transition: goal progress evidence was durable but not summarized back to the operator as a completion review
primary_review_findings.why_it_matters: A companion-style runtime should tell the operator what it completed, what it learned, what it retained, and what remains unresolved.
